name: two-real-services
title: Now two real services, built to agree on nothing
part: For real: two forges, one vocabulary
html:
Now two real services, built to agree on nothing

AWS stays a mockup. From here on, everything ran for real, and every request is on the record.

GitHub

the real one, in the cloud: JogoShugh/heart-github-test

GitLab

Community Edition, in a container on this machine
say: AWS stays a mockup: nobody serves it as HEART today. From here on everything ran for real, with every request recorded. Two real services, from two companies, that do mostly the same job and agree on almost nothing: GitHub, in the cloud, and GitLab, running on this machine.
